steps: record a deterministic scene with three named jellyfish
select a jellyfish through the pointer recognizer
advance one simulation frame and compute particle metrics
save the scene and verify its persisted identifier
record a color gesture at the selected jellyfish position
translate the gesture into a control panel command
apply the color and advance the particle field
query bright jellyfish and present metrics
select the third jellyfish from a canvas coordinate
expand its pulse using a control command
advance and render the selected frame
confirm selection and persisted control event
